propositions: Create-path membership test in outbound_differ uses case-sensitive comparison while applier guard normalizes to uppercase, causing disagreement when bridge_project case differs from mapping key (e.g. 'b' vs 'B').
Applier guard store-loading wiring (read_projects through apply) lacks end-to-end test coverage; only unit-tested at pure-helper level with literal sets.
run_differs outbound seam does not have fail-closed test for malformed projects.json; load_mapping ValueError propagation is unit-tested in isolation but not through the caller.
Mapping is read twice per pass (load_mapping in outbound seam and read_projects in applier guard), creating risk of disagreement on mid-pass projects.json changes.
Create-path membership check must be aligned with applier guard by making it case-insensitive and stamping the canonical mapping key for correct transport routing.
